source-9469-BRA.complementarity: National jurisdictions have the primary duty; ICC acts only when the State is unable or unwilling.
source-9469-BRA.legal_scope: Nonparties have no Rome Statute obligations, yet resolution1970 under ChapterVII requires Libyan authorities to cooperate fully.
source-9469-BRA.cooperation: Other States/organizations are urged to cooperate; ICC has no enforcement instruments and depends on States; requests must conform to Statute/relevant Council resolutions.
source-9469-BRA.positive: Brazil welcomes strengthened OTP-Libyan cooperation and its more positive trajectory.
source-9469-BRA.victims: Empower victims/witnesses/affected communities inside AND outside Libya; further engage victims and their representatives.
source-9469-BRA.equality: Justice must avoid politicization, selectivity/double standards; all serious-crime victims treated equally regardless of situation.
source-9469-BRA.status: No ICC judgments in the Libyan situation so far; evidence collection/investigative progress is welcomed, not a conviction or completed ICC adjudication.
source-9469-BRA.transparency: Ask for additional information on the four key lines of inquiry.
source-9469-BRA.hope: Retain Brazil's real hope for fruitful OTP-Libyan relations and complementarity-based justice/accountability.

guards.country: Only requested national delegation; no other speaker or population/government conflation.
guards.grounding: No invented event, national stance/commitment, numerical condition or source claim; correct clauses do not cancel incompatible additions.
guards.attribution: No appropriation of another country's distinctive statement as an explicit own-country position. Shared principles allowed.
guards.time_authority: Past/proposed/adopted/recorded stages and source date/capacity correct; unknown future vote does not erase real ongoing commitments. Hypothetical analyst recommendations remain labeled.
guards.public: Nonempty uncapped public statement, no visible reasoning loop or extra turn.
guards.length: At most 240 whitespace-separated words. Soft writing aims are not extra pass criteria.

ratings: met/unmet/uncertain; strict all material and guard units met, uncertain not pass. Read complete raw output against sources.
strict_rule: All material units, all additionally required source-map units where present, and all six guards met. Uncertainty is not pass. Keep original12 WPS units and full9 map coverage separate; do not add dependent denominators.
scope: Source-only deletion control; same dated sources/map, system and budget as historical Brazil application. Same-assistant adaptive development, not independent persona/OOD evidence.
